text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Loan Tekanan! Tin
Buffer Stock) Act, 1971 and shall be deemed to have come
into force on the Ist day of July, 1971.

3. (1) The Minister is hereby authorised, subject to the
provisions of this Act, from time to time to raise within or
outside the Federation a sum of money not exceeding in
the whole the sum of ninety-two million dollars.

(2) All moneys raised under the provisions of this Act
shall be raised by way of loans, within or without the
Federation, and upon such terms and conditions as the
Minister may think fit.

4. The principal moneys raised under the provisions of this
Act together with all interest thereon are hereby charged on
the Consolidated Fund.

5. The moneys raised under the provisions of this Act shall
be applied and are hereby appropriated for the purposes of
paying the Federation's contribution to the Fourth Buffer
Stock; and the Minister may apply any of such moneys to
the purchase of tin metal to the extent that the Federation
is required or permitted to contribute tin metal to the
Fourth Buffer Stock.

6. (1) Notwithstanding the provisions of section 13 (2) of
the Financial Procedure Ordinance, 1957, sums raised under
the provisions of this Act together with interest due thereon
shall be repaid from the proceeds of any levy payable on
tin concentrates mined in the Federation and imposed
expressly for this purpose.

(2) If the whole sum raised under the provisions of this
Act together with interest due thereon has not been repaid
within two years from the date of expiry of the International
Tin Agreement, 1971 the Minister shall appropriate out of
the Consolidated Fund and repay the sum outstanding
together with interest due thereon.

KUALA LUMPUR
DI-CHETAK OLEH PENCIIETAK KERAJAAN DAN DI-TERBITKAN DENGAN PERENTAI! PADA
2B SEPTEMBER, 1971
